message.content: {"basis": "The dashboard uses a dual-axis chart. The blue solid line, which corresponds to the 'U.S.' axis on the right, ends at a point in the upper-middle of the plot area in 2020. Visually, the U.S. value is significantly higher than the Rest of the world value. The task requires opening the follow-up record for the region with the larger 2020 value.
